display.title: Temples, Mansions & Outposts
description: Trapped temples, illager strongholds and mansions. Puzzles, traps and organised enemies guarding one real treasure room.
&ePrepare:&r Diamond gear or good affixes, fire resistance for pyramids, a bow.
&eSignature rewards:&r Ancient Cores in treasure rooms, higher-rarity affix rolls in the vault, charts to landmarks.
&eComing back:&r Mansions and outposts are rare per region; each is a one-time clear.
&eFeeds into:&r Cores -> ME controller, socketing, epic ink.
